name: EduPulse
summary: An AI-powered academic and career navigation platform that groups students by performance, builds personalised career roadmaps and keeps parents informed.
built: Student clustering with K-Means++ (scikit-learn) behind a Python Flask service
AI career roadmaps generated with Google Gemini
Parent alerts sent over SMTP, with the message written by Gemini
A gamified student space called Sparky World
A Gemini-powered chatbot
outcome: Built by Team AI OverLords. 3rd place among 114 teams at the International UAi Hawk-athon (Universal AI University, Karjat, 12-13 March 2026). Also entered Innovate Maharashtra, the Gemini and Gen AI Hackathon.

name: Route Resilience
summary: Road extraction from satellite imagery when trees, buildings and shadows hide parts of the road, plus a graph analysis of which road segments a city can least afford to lose.
problem: Road maps built from aerial images break wherever the road is hidden. Missing segments distort network reconstruction and any mobility analysis built on it.
built: Trained and evaluated HDDNet, a dual-decoder road-extraction model, on the DeepGlobe dataset in PyTorch
Fixed a decoder-collapse bug with auxiliary losses, an adjusted occlusion ratio and diagnostic logging
Occlusion experiments up to roughly 70 percent coverage
Graph-theoretic criticality analysis that ranks road segments by their effect on network connectivity
outcome: Final shipped model HDDNet v2 (epoch 30) reached a validation IoU of 0.5850, with max-ensemble and test-time augmentation as the recommended inference. Built by Team NeuralOrbit as ML engineer for the Bharatiya Antariksh Hackathon 2026 (ISRO x Hack2skill).

name: BrainBerry
summary: A gamified learning web app for children aged 4 to 8, built around a pre-primary school's own syllabus.
problem: Young children learn through play, and schools need digital lessons that follow the syllabus they already teach.
built: A 44-page installable web app (PWA) in vanilla JavaScript on Firebase
XP and progress for children, with a parent area protected by a hashed PIN
A face-based avatar using face-api.js
Lessons for Nursery to Sr. KG, with about 40 percent of the school's syllabus built so far
outcome: Adopted by a pre-primary school in Nashik. Content is being built grade by grade, starting with Nursery.

name: FinIQ
summary: An AI personal-finance app for Android and iOS, aimed at a Play Store launch.
problem: People stop tracking money when logging takes effort, so the app has to make daily expense entry take seconds and turn the data into advice.
built: Money Health Score across six dimensions, a FIRE planner and a tax wizard
Artha, an AI finance assistant on Gemini
Daily expense tracker, a markets screen and Smart Buy Lens (multimodal Gemini)
Flask API on MongoDB Atlas with Firebase Auth
outcome: Built with a team for the ET AI Hackathon 2026 and now being hardened toward a real launch.

name: Course and live-class platform
summary: A freelance build of an education platform with recorded courses, live classes and a manual access panel for the admin.
problem: A small teaching business needed to sell video courses and run live classes without building a media stack from scratch.
built: Course video playback
Live streaming sized for about 50 students at once
An admin panel to grant student access by hand
outcome: Planned as five phases over about two and a half weeks, built for a client.

name: ReGenFarm
summary: Turns crop residue from a disposal problem into a logistics one by pooling small farmers' supply to meet a buyer's minimum, then planning the collection route. Planned on Spring Boot and PostgreSQL with PostGIS.

name: NetramNova
summary: Explainable AI screening for diabetic retinopathy, for Smart India Hackathon 2026.

name: NashikNest
summary: Full-stack web app on React with PostgreSQL and Drizzle ORM.

name: Hostel Finder Nashik
summary: Helps students compare hostels in Nashik, with a responsive interface.

name: Student Record API
summary: REST API for creating, reading, updating and deleting student records, tested with Postman.

name: Personal Expense Tracker
summary: React app for logging expenses and seeing totals.
